fixes.where: index.html #journey (the five-stop track) vs #how-teaser and the persistent hww-panel
fixes.what: The home page explains the process three times (teaser options, the five-step journey, the slide-out tab) and the celebrations once. Remove the five-stop track from index.html (keep the 'Celebrations your family may choose' list and the Nowruz line as the tail of #celebrations), so the home runs hero → promise → celebrations → how we work → founder → inquire; the five steps live in the tab and how-we-work.html.
fixes.why: A family decides on 'do you know my wedding' first; repeating the process pushes the inquiry two screens further down.

fixes.where: site-footer__lang (all pages), how-we-work.html #you-get 'A page for the parents' and FAQ 'Which languages', index.html journey 'Proposal' note, index.html #f-lang options
fixes.what: Change every 'in Persian, Dari, Pashto, Urdu, Hindi or Punjabi' to '…Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi or the language your parents read, agreed in your proposal', and add Gujarati, Bengali and Tamil to the preferred-language select.
fixes.why: 'South Asian' is promised everywhere, but a Gujarati, Bengali or Tamil family reads the closed list as 'not for us'.

fixes.what: Replace 'and mixed couples are many of our families' with 'and mixed-heritage couples are welcome'.
fixes.why: A volume claim on a site with no proof line yet reads as puffery and undercuts the honest proof slot.

fixes.why: 'The sugar above' is opaque to the other family at a mixed wedding; the site's promise is fluency in exactly these details.
